title: DeskBox Plugin Manifest (schema v0 draft)
description: Draft manifest vocabulary for the DeskBox extension system. v0 exists to give the three-way runtime spike, the plugin CLI validator and the store specification one shared target; it will iterate and is intentionally lightly pinned by tests (existence + vocabulary, not field-by-field freezing). Design decisions: roadmap sections 13.2 (permissions), 13.4 (protocol skeleton), 13.5 (declarative UI), 14 (Extension Model) and 15 (store/commerce).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Unknown future versions must be rejected at install time (install-gate), not silently tolerated.

id.description: Package id, reverse-DNS style (e.g. com.github.stats). Package id != widget type id != widget instance id (three-level separation).

version.description: Package semver. Must increase on every store upload or the installer refuses (Rainmeter discipline).

publisher.description: Publisher identity. In the pre-account phase this is the Ed25519 publisher key fingerprint; later it binds to a registered account.

category.description: resource-pack: declarative-only, no code executes, store launch category. wasm: sandboxed component. out-of-proc: full-trust process (Windows code signing channel required, L1 review).

max.description: Maximum tested host API version; hosts above this may refuse or warn.

hostApi.description: Install-time half of the version double-gate; the runtime handshake protocolVersion is the other half (roadmap 13.4).

typeId.description: Widget type id, unique within the package; conventionally prefixed by the package id.

template.description: Host-rendered declarative template (roadmap 13.5). v0 deliberately has no free-form layout primitives.

version.description: Payload schema version; the host picks the parser by version, strict within a known version, unknown elements fall back per-element then drop.

payload.description: Template payload data + bindings. HostConfig owns theming; the payload never carries style.

activationEvents.description: Declarative activation events (roadmap 5.8): widgets restore their window/layout always; these decide when the plugin runtime starts.

items.description: Tauri-style identifier plugin-name:permission-name referencing a capability declaration. Granting happens through capabilities, not by listing here.

allow.description: e.g. directory globs (Downloads/**), URL filters (api.github.com), quotas (100/day).

deny.description: Deny always wins over allow (Tauri rule); the host additionally maintains defensive default-denies (own config/credential dirs).

context.description: Which plugin context (package / widget type) receives the grant.

defaultSet.description: Granted automatically at install with explicit UI notice (Tauri default.toml semantics).

data.description: Plugin-declared schema versions; the host runs backup -> migrate -> verify -> commit/rollback on updates (roadmap section 9 plugin schema migration clause).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the package contents (integrity, tier 1 of the three-tier signing model).

publisherKey.description: Ed25519 signature over the content hash (publisher identity, tier 2). Full-trust executables additionally require Windows code signing (tier 3) and ship through Store/WinGet channels.

fallback.description: UI payload degradation policy per roadmap 13.5 layer split: manifest strict / RPC envelope lenient / payload versioned-strict with per-element fallback.
